ema_contact_review.ema_psi1: Severe smeared/doubled mouth, cheek and chin anatomy across the sheet. Source-like hats/headwear, extra people, mixed apparent age/presentation and non-clerical context remain. Faces often look plastic or pasted. Not a usable fresh portrait distribution. Contact-only review: no exact per-image EMA eligibility count is claimed.
ema_contact_review.ema_psi07: Truncation reduces some variation but severe mouth/chin patches and uneven eyes persist. Obvious cap/hat-like heads remain at indices000,004,008,010. Youthful/ambiguous faces remain. White neck patches do not compensate for anatomy failures. No quality approval.

comparison_to_fixed500.finding: The fixed16 raw review found two catastrophic architecture-over-face cases. Seven of these independently predeclared32 new raw samples have severe head/face architecture corruption, including three catastrophic face occlusions, so the defect extends beyond the two saved fixed latents. Several intact raw samples retain recognizable faces and collars, consistent with fixed500 improvement in local legibility; neither this nor the descriptive failure fraction is a calibrated population estimate. Unlike fixed16, this set visibly includes hat-like heads, extra partial people, and one ordinary shirt/tie. EMA defects also persist on new seeds.
comparison_to_fixed500.diversity: Visible differences in hair, beard, apparent maturity, skin shading and modest pose exist, but related face templates, dark hair, slight turns/frontal layouts and Roman architecture dominate. No numerical diversity or irreversibility claim.
comparison_to_fixed500.decision: Keep checkpoint unapproved for production; continuation is a separate root decision. This review does not demonstrate irreversible collapse.
